$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this document. Studio ignores it.

name.description: The project name that the editor shows.

code.description: The Python script. Studio runs it after `loader.py`, which defines `datacube`, `reduced` and `add_graph_to_map`. Read `agents/script-contract.md`.

collectionId.description: The id of a collection of the openEO backend.

bands.description: The band ids of the collection, for example `reflectance|bands=b04`. The script reads `data[i]` in this order.

boundingBox.description: west, south, east, north in EPSG:4326 degrees.

cloudCover.description: The maximum cloud cover in percent. The default is 100.

description:
A sample that an external link loads into the editor.

An agent writes this document, encodes it, and gives the user the link `/editor?sample=<base64url(JSON)>` or `/editor?sampleUrl=<https URL>`. Studio loads it as a new unsaved project and never runs it on its own.

`scripts/generate-sample-schema.mjs` writes the JSON Schema of this type. Studio publishes the schema at `agents/sample.schema.json`.
title: openEO Studio prefill sample
$comment: Generated from app/types/sample-prefill.ts. Do not edit by hand. Run `pnpm schema:sample`.
